Play

Choose a game mode

6 maps

Campaign

Pick one of six hand-tuned battlefields, from gentle Greenfields to the Moon and the Ruined Warfront. Defend three villages from orc raids, add run modifiers or take on the daily challenge.

    CoreSpawns (6)Crystal
    Endless

    Headquarters

    Your core sits in the middle of a huge random map stitched together from every biome. Each round opens one more enemy direction until all six are open, and then the rounds just keep getting harder.

    MapAbout 3× the size · all five biomes · random every time Enemy directionsRound 1: 1 · round 2: 2 · round 6: all 6 Before round 11:00 to build Between rounds15s, once every enemy is dead Horde size70% more enemies every round (bosses stay the same) GoalHold wave 50 to win, then keep going VillagesNone. Just you and the core.
    Free build

    Sandbox

    Build anything you like for free, anywhere on the map, and upgrade or merge it for free too. Send any wave number or drop any monster wherever you want. The core can't fall, so test as wild an idea as you like. Nothing here counts toward tech points, bests or achievements.

    MapsAny of the six, locked ones included WavesOnly when you send them (or turn on Auto waves) Saved runIts own slot, separate from Campaign and Headquarters
    Factory defense · pick a battlefield

    Ore & Ordnance

    You fly the build drone. Mine ore, belt it home, and spend it on defenses and upgrades. Every map hides one crystal deposit far from your core, and tier 4 upgrades need crystal.
